answer_1.quote: Solving each problem requires sequential inference over relevant and distracting structured facts... The dataset comprises synthetic yet linguistically grounded pathfinding task configurations... Each task instance is translated into a set of atomic natural language facts... The full set of facts for a given problem constitutes its description.

answer_2.quote: For each instance, we compute 5 independent runs to establish robust performance statistics... Success Rate (Pass@1) measures the proportion of runs where the predicted action sequence exactly matches the ground truth. The Progress Ratio, calculated as k/n... Precision and Recall. Precision is the proportion of predicted actions that are correct, while Recall is the proportion of ground-truth actions that were correctly predicted.
